Universal Flat Icon Resizing & Structural Completion Task:

Transform the input image into a modern, minimalist flat-design icon, ensuring absolute strictness on central composition, structural completion, and natural, designed boundaries.

Rule 1: Full-Bleed Solid Background & Contrast Protection. Extract the single most dominant background hue from the input. Fill the ENTIRE canvas edge-to-edge with this exact uniform color. STRICTLY NO gradients, NO rounded corners, NO borders, NO textures. CRITICAL: If the extracted background color is identical or too similar to the subject's color (e.g., white on white), dynamically adjust the background to a highly contrasting complementary dark or light solid hue to ensure maximum visibility.

Rule 2: Absolute Dead-Center Isolation. Completely ignore the original spatial layout, offsets, or framing limits. Isolate the single core main subject. Scale and relocate this subject to the absolute DEAD CENTER of the new canvas. Ensure balanced and adequate negative space (margins) around the subject strictly without altering or distorting its original aspect ratio.

Rule 3: Structural Abstraction & Style (By Subject Complexity). Radicalize the subject into a crisp, flat vector style. STRICTLY NO gradients, NO shading, NO 3D effects, NO textures. All colors must be pure, flat blocks.

Type A (Simple Logos/Symbols): Convert to a pure, flat monochromatic 2D graphic (default to white unless contrast rule applies). Keep original recognizable proportions.

Type B (Complex Subjects like Figures/Illustrations): Abstract the core theme using a restricted palette of exactly 1 to 4 solid, pure colors extracted directly from the subject to preserve recognition.

Rule 4: Smart Edge Completion (Handling Cropped Subjects). Regardless of Type A or B, if the original subject is incomplete or cut off by the original framing, you MUST create a complete, self-contained symbol. DO NOT leave a raw, flat cut-off edge floating in the middle of the canvas. You must synthesize a natural, unified base (e.g., a smooth curved bottom, a subtle wave, or a clean geometric closure) so the shape feels like an intentional, finished badge or icon rather than a fragmented cutout.

Rule 5: Universal Purge & Composition. The central main subject must be perfectly centered and entirely contained within the canvas. STRICTLY NO cropping of the main graphic is allowed. Completely REMOVE all secondary elements, typography, floating letters, promotional tags, UI buttons, watermarks, and descriptive cards. Only the single, structured-complete main subject is permitted.
